comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable damper versus transfer and seat a strut across a keep-out region.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses hex-key insertion, collar adjustment, and torque-limited locking; record carries and aligns a long strut, may require handoff, and seats both ends into separated saddles without disturbing an obstacle.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe repeatable carriage stops; record requires both strut ends seated within tight pose tolerances while the protected housing remains within its displacement and tilt limits.
comparison.reason: Long-object transfer across a keep-out and dual-end seating do not test response-based adjustment. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift limits are undeclared.
